references.text: David expresses a feeling of abandonment by his closest ones, which mirrors Jesus' statement that his true family are those who do God's will.
The command to honor father and mother is put in a new light by Jesus' definition of his true family based on spiritual connection rather than just blood ties.
Jesus is referred to as the one who sanctifies, and those who are sanctified, all from one, which underscores the idea of a spiritual family.
Paul speaks of believers as God's household, which resonates with Jesus' message about spiritual family.
Peter encourages treating the Christian congregation as a family, reflecting Jesus' words about his disciples being his true family.
